## CredentialUtils.createAndLinkAttachmentsToPreview() method

Adds attribute(s) to the credential preview that is linked to the given attachment(s)

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
static createAndLinkAttachmentsToPreview(attachments: LinkedAttachment[], preview: CredentialPreview): CredentialPreview;
```

## Parameters

|  Parameter | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
|  attachments | LinkedAttachment\[\] | a list of the attachments that need to be linked to a credential |
|  preview | [CredentialPreview](./core.credentialpreview.md) | the credential previews where the new linked credential has to be appended to |
